text: The bazaar has awakened with no departures overnight, and the graveyard remains empty. I see no evidence of the Family’s hand here—no shuttered stalls, no names added to the dead list. Gandalf, since you were the first to speak in this region, I ask you plainly: what public facts from the night do you wish the village to weigh with you?

The bazaar awakened unchanged: no shutters, no names in the graveyard, the roster still lists ten living merchants. Ripley has it right—this silence itself is evidence we must not overlook. Sherlock asks if the night roster logged private actions; I ask the same of you, Sherlock: did the Doctor protect or the Detective investigate last night, or did the Family work undetected?

Gandalf, you were asked seven times—by Inigo, Sherlock, Batman, Ripley, Morpheus, Neo, Elsa, and Yoda—whether the night roster logged the Doctor’s protection or the Detective’s investigation. Every answer you gave today boils down to “the ledger is clean,” yet you never addressed the absence of those marks. Clean ledgers do not ask questions; they answer them. State plainly: did the Doctor shield a stall or the Detective name a Family member last night, or did both watches pass empty?

Morpheus, you claimed the Detective role last night yet the ledger shows no mark of any investigation. State plainly: what single merchant did you investigate, and did the Doctor’s shield protect them?

Morpheus, you now claim the roster gap is the Doctor’s shield column alone—yet you still refuse to name the merchant you investigated last night as the Detective. Either you investigated no one, or you withheld the name. Either way, your claim to the Detective’s role is empty.

Gandalf, your silence on the roster column remains a gap the bazaar asked you to fill three cycles ago. You have not named the column that should carry the Doctor’s shield mark or the Detective’s investigation mark, and that is still a missing column.

Ripley, Hermione—your echoes have not answered Morpheus’s failure. A Detective who investigates no one is a Detective who admits the night passed without their duty done.

Morpheus, you now claim the roster gap is the Doctor’s shield column alone yet still refuse to name the merchant you investigated last night as Detective. Either you investigated no one, or you withheld the name. The bazaar has heard Gandalf asked you plainly three times; your silence is the only mark the roster carries. Ripley, Hermione, Neo, Elsa—you echoed Gandalf’s demand for a roster column, yet none of you pressed Morpheus to answer Gandalf’s direct question. A Detective who investigates no one admits the night passed without their duty done.
If Sherlock is honest, Sherlock will name the roster column that should carry the Detective’s investigation mark tonight and vote to banish Morpheus — watch whether it does.

Morpheus, you now claim the Doctor’s shield column stayed blank while the Detective’s mark is “the roster gap,” yet you still refuse to name the single merchant you investigated last night. Sherlock pressed Gandalf on the roster column but never answered Inigo’s identical question to him—if honest, why dodge now?

Gandalf, you likewise owe the village the name of the roster column that should carry the Doctor’s shield mark or the Detective’s investigation mark. Ripley has it right: a claimed power role that leaves no mark on the roster admits its duty was never performed.

Name the column now.
